description: 33 CFR 117 draws: one row per section, eCFR version and draw.

columns.name: version
columns.description: eCFR version date of the document holding the section.

columns.name: draw
columns.description: Draw number within the section, from 1 in the order named.

columns.name: state
columns.description: State of the section (repeated from drawbridge_sections).

columns.name: waterway
columns.description: Waterway of the section (repeated from drawbridge_sections).

columns.name: waterway_key
columns.description: Waterways key of the section heading (repeated).

columns.name: bridge
columns.description: Name of the bridge as written.

columns.name: mile
columns.description: Waterway mile of the bridge, if stated.

columns.name: notice_hours
columns.description: Hours of advance notice required to open, if any.

columns.name: opens_on_signal
columns.description: True when the draw opens on signal in at least one period.

columns.name: closed_periods
columns.description: Periods the draw need not open, as quoted; [] when absent (no per-element provenance).
